entity.name: VasakOS
entity.description: VasakOS is a community-driven Linux distribution based on Arch Linux, built in Argentina. It ships its own desktop environment and a full set of native applications written from scratch in Rust and Vue on top of Tauri and Wayland. The project is developed in the open under the Vasak-OS organisation on GitHub and has no corporate backing: it is sustained by its maintainers and by community donations.

projects.name: VasakOS
projects.description: A Linux distribution with its own Wayland desktop and around thirty native applications — file manager, terminal, settings, mail, calendar, contacts, gallery, store, installer, keyring, a PolicyKit agent and a per-application permission system for camera, microphone and screen capture. Everything is written in Rust and Vue on Tauri, packaged for pacman, and shipped as a live ISO with a graphical installer.
